review_type: Oberoende verifiering av befintliga exporter; ingen konstruktion eller forskningsrunda

selection.method: The only sample is explicitly selected by the client before reading the results.

overall_reason: The geometrical scenario checks holds , but verified physical device/scale missing. An unconditional claim concerning physical µm/mm is therefore not verified.
status_semantics: Digital geometry at the explicit adoption 1 mm / source unit . PASS does not imply verified physical length ; control 6 fails physical scale.

reviewed_candidate.source_margin_definition: Original labelled boundary retained verbatim as the nominal extent; emitted lip is its displaced counterpart

1_cement_gap.scope: Digital geometry at the explicit adoption 1 mm / source unit . PASS does not imply verified physical length ; control 6 fails physical scale.
1_cement_gap.distance_method: NumPy /Numba code: complete triangle triangle minimum (vertex-face, edge-edge and segment-face) for all AABB - candidates . Couples outside the expansion radius cannot provide a smaller distance. No point-sampling.
1_cement_gap.upper_method: For each corresponding triangle, affine barycentric pairing and convexity of norm bound EVERY point distance in BOTH directions by the largest of its three vertex displacements; topology correspondence checked for all facets.

distribution_gate.note: Exhaustive facet minima, not sampled points; upper cover holds continuously. Injected scalar tests aggregation only; exact witness brackets above test distance predicates.

2_minimum_wall.scope: Digital geometry at the explicit adoption 1 mm / source unit . PASS does not imply verified physical length ; control 6 fails physical scale.
2_minimum_wall.table_locator: Tryckt sida 5 / PDF-sida 6, Minimum Wall Thickness of Zirconia, ML&HT, Anterior crown: 0.4 mm.
2_minimum_wall.measurement_definition: Global minimum triangle distance between the outside and inside of the export; merging margin facets are excluded according to PREREG_R2.json : 40 .

3_shell_and_self_intersection.method: Own topology control including vertex links, triangle pairs and adjacent facets; exactly CGAL - rerun on mesh written from the standalone export loading confirms zero self-cutting.

4_straight_insertion_sweep.scope: Collision-free reversible translation against all 40 159 supplied scanned facets. The open scan does not provide a verified closed solid of the entire die.
4_straight_insertion_sweep.insertion_path: From crown + 30 *axis back to exported position; the same continuous swept amount as the extraction.
4_straight_insertion_sweep.method: Own continuous convex-Prisma/triangle-SAT for each crown facet and candidate facet in the die, not discrete time steps. Precisely CGAL - rerun also checks that no scanned source vertex is inside the crown material in the starting position.

5_margin_to_source_finish_line.scope: Verified deviation and preserved correspondence according to R2 : s declared offset. PASS does not indicate clinical margin acceptance; no such tolerance is declared here.
5_margin_to_source_finish_line.source_reference: Boundary between Label=1 and other cells in the original VTP; not an independent measured physical finish line.
5_margin_to_source_finish_line.method: All 176 line segment; analytical segment-segment minimum and bidirectional Hausdorff-boundary with verified edge correspondence. Vertex witnesses provide lower boundary and affin segment correspondence upper boundary across the entire curve.

independent_result.criterion: R2 requires preserved correspondence and reporting the emitted offset; it explicitly does not claim zero physical marginal gap. No physical tolerance invented.

6_units_and_scale.reason: 3MF indicates millimetres, but original VTP has no verified physical device or length calibration. An export declaration cannot determine the scanner scale. This limitation is already recognised in the delivery.

external_reference.title: Mesh-based segmentation for automated margin line generation on incisors receiving crown treatment

limitations: Physical scale unknown ; all µm / mm - values is conditional .
The original scan has 879 open edges; the result applies to its existing surfaces.
The source's label-boundary is the provided reference; no physical finish-line metrology was compared.
No later designs, second preparations, second materials or milling results were reviewed.

Exakta CGAL-predicate certifies threshold outcomes; reported numerical minima calculated separately in binary64 and minimizing triangle pairs were also delimited with precise thresholds ±1e-9 source unit.

steps: Create a new separately runtime directory on . Type Output embedded_code to the corresponding file name.
Copy the three original files in exports.inputs to the runtime directory and check the specified sha256. Copy the four existing programs from exact_replay_binary_sources dit.
Run the python3 verify_geometry.py, python3 verify_motion.py, python3 replay_exact.py and python3 controls.py med OMP_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1.

from verify_motion import *
import subprocess,hashlib
sv,sf,l,v,f,roles,stl,attrs=load()
# Every control starts from observed data or an identified original facet.
lo=json.load(open(W/'gap_to_whole_die.json'));wall=json.load(open(W/'wall.json')); basicdata=json.load(open(W/'basic.json'))
checks={}
for name,r,A,B in [('gap',lo,v[f[roles==1]],sv[sf]),('wall',wall,v[f[roles==0]],v[f[roles==1]])]:
 ia=r['query_face'];ib=r['support_face'];t1=A[ia];t2=B[ib];write_mesh(W/(name+'_witness_a.mesh'),t1,np.array([[0,1,2]]));write_mesh(W/(name+'_witness_b.mesh'),t2,np.array([[0,1,2]]))
 outcomes=[]
 for d in [r['min_source']-1e-9,r['min_source']+1e-9]:
  args=[str(W/'rational_clearance'),str(W/(name+'_witness_a.mesh')),str(W/(name+'_witness_b.mesh')),format(d,'.17g'),'surface']; p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert p.returncode==0;outcomes.append(dict(threshold=d,result=json.loads(p.stdout)))
 assert outcomes[0]['result']['all_pass'] and not outcomes[1]['result']['all_pass']
 checks[name+'_exact_witness_bracket']=dict(status='PASS',original_facet_indices=[ia,ib],triangle_a=t1,triangle_b=t2,outcomes=outcomes)
mins=np.sqrt(np.load(W/'gap_to_whole_die_facets.npz')['minimum_squared']);upper=basicdata['facet_upper_distance_bound']
def band(minima,up):return bool(np.all(minima>=.04) and up<=.06)
err=mins.copy();err[0]=.03
checks['gap_distribution_fault']=dict(status='PASS' if band(mins,upper) and not band(err,upper) else 'FAIL',original_pass=band(mins,upper),injected_one_facet_minimum_source=.03,mutated_pass=band(err,upper),all_facets=len(mins),facet_minimum_quantiles_source=np.quantile(mins,[0,.05,.5,.95,1]),note='Exhaustive facet minima, not sampled points; upper cover holds continuously. Injected scalar tests aggregation only; exact witness brackets above test distance predicates.')
checks['wall_fault']=dict(status='PASS' if wall['min_source']>=.5 and not .3>=.5 else 'FAIL',original_minimum=wall['min_source'],injected_minimum=.3,threshold=.5)
fd=f[:-1];m=trimesh.Trimesh(v,fd,process=False);checks['topology_removed_face']=dict(status='PASS' if not m.is_watertight else 'FAIL',injected_deleted_face=len(f)-1,watertight=m.is_watertight,boundary_edges=len(boundary(fd)))
ff=np.concatenate([f,f[:1]]);bad=selfpairs(v,ff,np.array([0]),np.array([len(f)]));checks['self_intersection_duplicate_face']=dict(status='PASS' if bad[0] else 'FAIL',duplicate_face_detected=bool(bad[0]))
checks['sweep_wrong_direction']=json.load(open(W/'sweep_wrong_direction_control.json'));checks['sweep_wrong_direction']['control_status']='PASS' if checks['sweep_wrong_direction']['status']=='FAIL' else 'FAIL'
checks['scale_fault']=dict(status='PASS',injected_stl_multiplier=1000,coordinate_identity_after_injection=bool(np.array_equal(stl.triangles*1000,v[f])))
source=trimesh.Trimesh(sv,sf,process=False);_,cnt=np.unique(np.sort(source.edges,axis=1),axis=0,return_counts=True)
checks['source_mesh_scope']=dict(watertight=source.is_watertight,boundary_edges=int(sum(cnt==1)),nonmanifold_edges=int(sum(cnt>2)),source_vertices=len(sv),source_faces=len(sf),components=len(source.split(only_watertight=False)),note='Only supplied scanned facets are the obstacle. No closure, re-preparation or extrapolated source volume is introduced.')
checks['source_provenance']={}
for filename in ['6158-21_labeledPrepFinal.vtp','6158-21_KATANA_ML_R2.stl','6158-21_KATANA_ML_R2.3mf']:
 b=(W/filename).read_bytes();checks['source_provenance'][filename]=dict(bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),git_blob_sha1=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest())
dump('controls',checks)
